transactions.input_byte_basis: Admission budget estimate, including retained gameplay snapshots; not socket bytes or measured heap allocation

network.datagram_byte_basis: Actual successful UDP socket payload bytes, including application headers, fragments, ACKs and retries; excludes UDP/IP headers
network.control_byte_basis: WebSocket application bytes; submitted bytes are queued by UE, not proof of socket delivery

peers.encoding_byte_basis: First-transmitted logical records; encoded_bytes excludes motion_batch_shared_bytes and sent_packet_header_bytes; no retry or UDP/IP bytes. Canonical uses the same body or explicit reference body.
